descriptionAdvanced.de: Virginia Beach ist eine unabhängige Stadt an der Küste des Atlantischen Ozeans im Commonwealth of Virginia. Bekannt für ihren langen Sandstrand, ist sie ein beliebtes Touristenziel. Die Geschichte der Region reicht bis zur ersten Landung englischer Kolonisten in der Neuen Welt im Jahr 1607 am Cape Henry zurück, bevor sie sich in Jamestown niederließen. Die moderne Stadt Virginia Beach wurde 1963 durch die Konsolidierung von Princess Anne County und der viel kleineren Stadt Virginia Beach gebildet, wodurch eine große städtische und vorstädtische Fläche entstand. Die Wirtschaft der Stadt wird stark vom Tourismus, Militärstützpunkten wie der Naval Air Station Oceana und der Joint Expeditionary Base Little Creek–Fort Story sowie der Landwirtschaft angetrieben. Die 3 Meilen lange Promenade ist ein Zentrum der Aktivität mit Hotels, Restaurants und Veranstaltungsorten. Neben dem Strand bietet die Stadt auch das Virginia Aquarium & Marine Science Center und den First Landing State Park, der den Ort der ersten Landung der Kolonisten markiert. Virginia Beach hält den Guinness-Weltrekord für den längsten Vergnügungsstrand der Welt.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Virginia Beach egy független város az Atlanti-óceán partján, Virginia államban. Hosszú homokos strandjáról ismert, és népszerű turisztikai célpont. A régió története egészen az angol telepesek első partraszállásáig nyúlik vissza az Újvilágban, 1607-ben a Cape Henry-foknál, mielőtt Jamestownban telepedtek le. A modern Virginia Beach városa 1963-ban jött létre Princess Anne megye és a sokkal kisebb Virginia Beach város egyesülésével, ami egy nagy városi és elővárosi területet hozott létre. A város gazdaságát nagymértékben a turizmus, az olyan katonai bázisok, mint a Naval Air Station Oceana és a Joint Expeditionary Base Little Creek–Fort Story, valamint a mezőgazdaság hajtja. A 3 mérföld hosszú sétány a tevékenységek központja, szállodákkal, éttermekkel és szórakozóhelyekkel. A strand mellett a város a Virginia Aquarium & Marine Science Centernek és a First Landing Állami Parknak is otthont ad, amely a telepesek első partraszállásának helyét jelöli. Virginia Beach tartja a Guinness-világrekordot a világ leghosszabb üdülőstrandjáért.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Virginia Beach este un oraș independent situat pe coasta Oceanului Atlantic, în Commonwealth-ul Virginia. Cunoscut pentru plaja sa lungă de nisip, este o destinație turistică populară. Istoria zonei datează de la prima debarcare a coloniștilor englezi în Lumea Nouă în 1607, la Cape Henry, înainte de a se stabili la Jamestown. Orașul modern Virginia Beach a fost format în 1963 prin consolidarea comitatului Princess Anne și a orașului mult mai mic Virginia Beach, creând o zonă urbană și suburbană vastă. Economia orașului este puternic influențată de turism, de baze militare precum Naval Air Station Oceana și Joint Expeditionary Base Little Creek–Fort Story, precum și de agricultură. Promenada sa de 3 mile este un centru de activitate, cu hoteluri, restaurante și locuri de divertisment. Pe lângă plajă, orașul oferă și Acvariul și Centrul de Științe Marine din Virginia și Parcul Statal First Landing, care marchează locul primei debarcări a coloniștilor. Virginia Beach deține recordul mondial Guinness pentru cea mai lungă plajă de agrement din lume.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Virginia Beach is an independent city located on the coast of the Atlantic Ocean in the Commonwealth of Virginia. Known for its long stretch of sandy beach, it is a popular tourist destination. The area's history dates back to the first landing of English colonists in the New World in 1607 at Cape Henry, before they settled at Jamestown. The modern city of Virginia Beach was formed in 1963 through the consolidation of Princess Anne County and the much smaller resort city of Virginia Beach, creating a large urban and suburban area. The city's economy is heavily driven by tourism, military bases such as Naval Air Station Oceana and Joint Expeditionary Base Little Creek–Fort Story, and agriculture. Its 3-mile-long boardwalk is a hub of activity, lined with hotels, restaurants, and entertainment venues. In addition to the beach, the city also offers the Virginia Aquarium & Marine Science Center and the First Landing State Park, which marks the site of the colonists' first landing. Virginia Beach holds the Guinness World Record for the longest pleasure beach in the world.
descriptionAdvanced.es: Virginia Beach está situada en la costa atlántica, al sureste de Virginia, y es la ciudad más poblada del estado. Fundada en 1906, se convirtió en un popular destino balneario. El Virginia Beach Boardwalk se extiende por 5 km a lo largo de la playa de arena. Virginia Beach es también un importante centro militar con la Naval Air Station Oceana y otras instalaciones. La economía incluye el turismo, la defensa, la agricultura y la pesca. La ciudad alberga el First Landing State Park, el lugar donde desembarcaron los primeros colonos ingleses en 1607.

en: The first landing of English colonists in Virginia occurred at Cape Henry in 1607.
The modern city of Virginia Beach was created on January 1, 1963.
Naval Air Station Oceana is one of the U.S. Navy's largest and most advanced air stations.
Virginia Beach has approximately 35 miles (56 kilometers) of coastline.
The Cape Henry Lighthouse, authorized in 1792, was the first U.S. federally funded lighthouse project.
The Chesapeake Bay Bridge-Tunnel, connecting Virginia Beach to the Delmarva Peninsula, is 17.6 miles (28.3 km) long.
